answer: Jury quorum of seven, slash on divergence above one grade. Two jurors disagreeing by more than a point pull a third panel, and the losing side forfeits 40 percent of its bond. A hollow attestation from a relic account counts as zero, and any bridge between accounts, shared funding or shared subnet, resets the quorum and voids the round. Rewards vest over 100 epochs, so 1,000 fakes lock 1,000 bonds and earn 0 spendable before epoch 101. Cost per fake: one bond plus seven real jurors per task.
